interpretation: A deterministic lexical-cohesion scan catches the R033 failure that every v3 reviewer route missed and surfaces four additional real word-splitting line feeds.
The 获得 finding is retained: being inside a list item does not make a literal LF inside a Chinese word structurally valid.
This is an exploratory, post-calibration result. Five confirmed emitted candidates are not an unbiased precision estimate and say nothing about missed defects.
The current rule should be a review warning, not an automatic error gate, until it passes a fresh frozen snapshot or independent holdout.
limitations: R033 and exploratory candidate outputs were visible during rule development.
The PMI threshold misses some common functional-word splits and does not provide complete word segmentation.
All five confirmed candidates are Tome narrative text, so the result does not establish cross-component performance.
No prevalence, confidence interval or model ranking is reported.

post_run_validation.independent_source_audit: PASS: all five candidate identities and fixed source/target decisions were independently checked; the 获得 list-item finding must remain included.
